title: RETHINKING LLM-AS-A-JUDGE: REPRESENTATION-AS-A-JUDGE WITH SMALL LANGUAGE MODELS VIA SEMANTIC CAPACITY ASYMMETRY
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of evaluating language models using internal representations, specifically testing logicality, factuality, and informativeness on math and science reasoning benchmarks. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
